dog.description_text:
“Whenever, wherever
We’re meant to be together
I’ll be there, and you’ll be near
And that’s the deal, my dear”

This Shakira is no She Wolf—she’s a lover girl. ❤️ She’s a cuddle bug who loves curling up by you with the softest, sweetest puppy eyes. She’s also an independent girlie who feels comfortable in her crate, can’t resist a fuzzy dog bed, and quickly understands boundaries, especially as she learns self-control in her puppy teething era.

While Shakira is still too little for walks beyond brief potty breaks, she happily follows your lead and will take any chance to sit next to you or between your legs. She loves to quietly observe passersbys from her carrier and makes for a perfect brunch or coffee date companion. She’s also incredibly proud of learning how to climb steps and will happily show off her new skills with her tail wagging.

Shakira can be a little shyer and more reserved at first, but underneath that gentle nature is a wonderfully confident and curious little girl. Give her a moment to take things in, and she’ll soon be right there beside you, ready to play, explore, or settle in for a cuddle.

Shakira would make the sweetest companion for someone looking for an affectionate little sidekick. Whenever, wherever—you just might be the person she’s meant to be together with. 💕

﻿Shakira is approximately 0y 5m 12d old and may be 13 to 27 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
